proposed_regression_criteria_for_parent: Every meaning-bearing label must remain readable against its actual background throughout reveal, hold and exit; annotations must not cross the label or its clear space.
Drawn paths must have intentional source and destination, and their staged appearance must be checked in continuous playback rather than certified from a final still.
Every photographic composite must be checked at late/full arrival states as well as early hero frames; no hard cut through a hand, object or screen.
A warning, comparison or data-transfer beat must visibly express its intended relationship. Generic illustration must not be presented as source proof.
On-screen words must identify objects, add checked evidence, label a necessary distinction or provide a usable action; metadata credits stay in evidence records where the house rule requires.
Inspect the assembled full-cut intro, body and ending together to catch duplicate endings or wrapper-induced pacing; a scene-level render cannot certify final sequencing.
Bind review to the actual candidate hash and separate sampled visual checks, continuous listening/playback, phone clarity and human taste approval.
Styleframe approval and approval of unchanged audio do not approve the assembled full visual cut.
authority_note: These are review-derived regression criteria proposed for parent integration, not a new self-approved taste standard. No source, harness, shared status or historical decision record was edited.
